brief: The user rejected v4 as too techy and requested a more organic direction. Explore fluid contours, controlled asymmetry and softer lowercase typography while retaining premium product polish.

concepts.name: Tidal
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create one polished logo concept for the brand "cymba", a premium audio product. The user rejected rigid geometric technology logos and wants something a bit more ORGANIC. The identity should feel fluid, tactile, natural and quietly confident, with the sophistication of a beautifully designed everyday object. Use smooth asymmetric curves, relaxed proportions and subtle stroke variation, not mechanically perfect geometry. Keep it simple and exceptionally well drawn.
Flat charcoal artwork on a uniform off-white background. Landscape 3:2 concept board: large horizontal primary logo in the upper middle; along the lower quarter, a small version at left and the identical logo in white on a modest charcoal swatch at right. Generous whitespace. These are repetitions of exactly one design.
Exact text: "cymba" in lowercase only. No headings, captions, slogans or extra words. Clean vector-like edges. No gradients, shadows, texture, 3D or product mockups. Avoid sharp corners, squared letters, futuristic typography, circuits, mechanical monograms, wellness clichés, leaves, lotus, hearts and infinity signs. It should feel like a distinctive premium product identity, not a spa or a children's brand.
Design direction: TIDAL. A small open c-shaped gesture drawn as one continuous softly swelling organic stroke. Imagine the effortless motion of a small wave folding back upon itself: the upper curve is compact, the lower curve opens gently outward. Use beautifully balanced asymmetric curvature, subtly varying width, and softly tapered blunt ends. It should have a clear, simple silhouette, not a spiral, brush-texture drawing or 3D ribbon. A feeling of ease and movement.
Pair with beautifully crafted lowercase "cymba": medium-weight humanist sans serif, gently curved terminals, open counters, slightly varying stroke width, an easy curved y descender, and a single-storey a. Natural readable letterforms, warm but restrained, thoughtful kerning. The symbol is modest, approximately the height of the lowercase wordmark including its ascenders. The small lower-left sample is the standalone symbol.
concepts.review: Visually reviewed: legible cymba text, organic curves, unclipped light and reversed presentations.

Design direction: PEBBLE. Design a compact abstract emblem formed by two gently unequal, river-smoothed solid pebble shapes nestled close together, with one generous flowing gap between them. One form is broader and concave, the other smaller and rounder, creating a quietly distinctive overall silhouette and a soft hint of a C in the negative space. The forms should feel naturally found and carefully composed, never bilaterally symmetrical, never like a pause button, chain link, quotation marks, leaf or yin-yang. Only two flat solid shapes, with generous open space so it works at tiny scale.
Pair with a calm lowercase "cymba" wordmark in a softly drawn medium-weight humanist sans serif: natural proportions, gently rounded terminals, a flowing y and beautifully spaced letters. Avoid geometric circular font construction and avoid bubble letters. Symbol on left, wordmark on right; balance them optically without overpowering the name. The small lower-left sample is the standalone pebble emblem.
